rules.title: Broker fees must be paid by party who contracted with broker
rules.quote: Any fee shall only be paid by the party, lessor or tenant who originally engaged and entered into a contract with the licensed broker or salesperson.
rules.summary: A broker fee for finding rental housing can only be paid by the party (landlord or tenant) who originally hired and contracted with the broker.
rules.effective_date_evidence: Text of section as amended by 2025, 9, Sec. 43 effective August 1, 2025.  See 2025, 9, Sec. 136.
